qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Operates as a network-independent reseller (MVNO) dependent on wholesale access contracts from Deutsche Telekom, Vodafone, and Telefónica Deutschland, alongside an IPTV service (waipu.tv). Lacks pricing power in commoditized mobile plans, resulting in 5-year median GAAP ROIC below the 12% threshold.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3 (Moat & Pricing Power). Operates as a mobile reseller (MVNO) without own network infrastructure and IPTV provider (waipu.tv). Sub-hurdle historical capital efficiency (5-year median GAAP ROIC ~8-10% vs 12% threshold) and negligible pricing power amid aggressive discount mobile competition.
qualitative.evidence: freenet acts as a service provider dependent on network operator wholesale agreements. Multi-year GAAP ROIC hovers around 8-10%, failing the 12% hurdle. German mobile tariff competition severely limits standalone price hikes, forcing reliance on SG&A discipline and high dividend payouts rather than economic moat expansion.
